name: cinexis-home
description: CINEXIS Home — enrolment, local Home Assistant integration and ingress UI. No tunnel client, no shell, no privileged support functionality.
//: NO DEPENDENCIES. The Node standard library covers everything this app does, and an owner-facing app that runs in every house should carry the smallest dependency graph we can manage. It is also why there is no scanned-session WhatsApp library here, directly or transitively.
